title: Hidden-retention pass: share one removal-duty predicate with the blocker, and broaden the oracle fixture
outcome: The commit-time hidden-retention pre-filter can never become narrower than the removal blocker, and its equivalence with the per-session reference is guarded for the topologies the argument depends on.
acceptance: One shared function decides the removal duty (runtime_observation_has_removal_duty || source_root_bind_owner) and is used by both source_observation_removal_blocker and retain_hidden_source_observation_sessions.

The reference-oracle fixture adds a child with several parents, a delegation cycle or self-delegation, a delegation whose parent or child session is missing, and a runtime-observation duty, and the compared image includes mutation_stamp.
The scaling diagnostic does not run the quadratic reference at 8,400 hidden sessions on every suite run (#[ignore] or a smaller default).
